# Release codenames, one per line: TAG=Code Name
#
# codenv names releases after Canadian provinces and territories.
#
#   The MAJOR version is the province.
#     v1.x  Saskatchewan
#     v2.x  Manitoba
#     v3.x  Alberta
#     v4.x  British Columbia
#
#   The MINOR version is a place within that province. v1.0 is the province
#   as a whole, and each minor release names somewhere inside it.
#     v1.1  Regina        v2.1  Churchill
#     v1.2  Fort Quapelle v2.2  Winnipeg
#     v1.3  Moose Jaw     v2.3  Brandon
#     v1.4  Saskatoon
#
# The release workflow reads this file so a codename can never be inherited by
# accident from a previous release: an unlisted tag simply has no codename.
# Reorder or rename entries freely; only the tag has to match.

# Saskatchewan
v1.0=Saskatchewan
v1.1=Regina
v1.2=Fort Quapelle
v1.3=Moose Jaw
v1.4=Saskatoon

# Manitoba
v2.0=Manitoba
v2.1=Churchill
v2.2=Winnipeg
v2.3=Brandon

# Alberta
v3.0=Alberta

# British Columbia
v4.0=British Columbia
